records.title: Second-part instruction on measures for the security of a group
records.header_literal: Page heading 13th November 1918; A) 2 TL; RICHI-202
records.readable_german: HIFUERU. Alle fuer die Sicherheit der Gruppe NOTIGEN MASSREGLN nach eigenem Ermessen zu treffen. OHL RM1A NR11??? GEH OP.
records.meaning: The surviving second part calls for taking the necessary measures for the security of the group according to one’s own discretion. The opening HIFUERU remains unexplained, and the particular group and reference number are not identified. This is an instruction fragment, not evidence that the measures were carried out.
notes: The printed second-part body has 202 valid source coordinates and matches its RICHI-202 header. High-resolution inspection confirms five glyphs in the last complete five-coordinate group FXVFA, followed by DG and a clear final G in DXGFG. No source erasure, insertion or deletion is introduced.
The first part is not supplied. HIFUERU remains a literal unexplained opening, rather than being shortened or rewritten into a familiar introductory word.
NOTIGEN and MASSREGLN are retained exactly; missing vowel letters in familiar spellings are not silently inserted.

The proposal repairs SIMHERHEIT, DE6 to DER, EIG?NEM, ERMASSEN and ZUTR?FFEN at six observed-coordinate substitutions. The 6 in DE6 is a known label and its change is paid for. The two question marks in EIG?NEM and ZUTR?FFEN come from the fully observed unassigned AF square cell; proposing E at each position is separately paid for by coordinate changes, not by changing the key.

The first and third unknowns in the final NR11??? field are the same fully observed GA square cell, at plaintext 93 and 95. The middle unknown is the distinct GD cell at 94. The two cells must receive different members of {2,3,4,7,8,9,Q,Y}; no assumption that the labels are digits is imposed.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.
